fields.title: Facebook group post record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one post per row. One POST row per post, COMMENT rows when Facebook served comment bodies, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a group cannot be read. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The group slug or id this record came from.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: group_unavailable, feed_unavailable or unexpected_error.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Why the group could not be read - private, missing, or feed not public.

groupPrivacy.title: Privacy
groupPrivacy.description: OPEN or CLOSED, as Facebook reports it.

groupMemberCount.title: Members
groupMemberCount.description: Member count parsed from the label. Facebook abbreviates large counts ('117.4K members'), so this is approximate and the raw label is kept next to it.

groupMemberCountLabel.title: Members (as shown)
groupMemberCountLabel.description: The member count exactly as Facebook rendered it.

text.title: Post text
text.description: The post body. Null when the post carries only media.

createdAtIso.title: Posted at
createdAtIso.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the post.

authorName.title: Author
authorName.description: Name of the member who posted. Null when Facebook withheld it.

authorId.title: Author ID
authorId.description: Facebook id of the author. Newer accounts appear as an opaque pfbid token rather than a number.

commentCount.title: Comments
commentCount.description: How many comments the post has. Published by Facebook even though the comment text is not - see commentsServed.

commentsServed.title: Comment bodies served
commentsServed.description: How many comment bodies Facebook actually returned for this post. For group posts on a logged-out request this is 0 while commentCount can be large; the two are reported separately rather than pretending they agree.

shareCount.title: Shares
shareCount.description: Share count, where Facebook reports one.

attachmentUrls.title: Attachment URLs
attachmentUrls.description: Photo and video CDN links found on the post. These are signed URLs and expire.

commentIndex.title: Comment index
commentIndex.description: COMMENT rows only: position within the post's served comments.

overview.title: Posts
overview.description: One row per post: who said what, when, and how it landed.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Sort by reactions or comments to find what the community actually responded to.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Comment bodies, where Facebook served them.
